repo_notes.author: timerloggedout-spec
repo_notes.content: This is an Android/Termux-first agentic-development monorepo. Start with README.md, AGENTS.md, and docs/icm/CLAUDE.md; treat repository-local source, reviewed commits, and current workflow files as authoritative over generated summaries or historical artifacts.

repo_notes.author: timerloggedout-spec
repo_notes.content: The Wiki contract is validation-first. wiki/ is the reviewable source projected to GitHub Wiki by .github/workflows/publish-wiki.yml. Public DeepWiki and Devin Wiki are documentation discovery aids, not GitHub writers or authorization evidence.

repo_notes.author: timerloggedout-spec
repo_notes.content: Repository-surface reconciliation is documented in docs/agentic/repository-surface-reconciliation.md. It discovers only repositories reachable by the existing job-scoped credential lane, reports state read-only on schedule, and creates reviewable pull requests only after an explicit apply request.

pages.title: Repository Orientation and Operating Context
pages.purpose: Explain the Android/Termux-first target, the root navigation paths, the evidence-led change model, and the ICM sources that orient a contributor before a change.

pages.title: Agentic Control Plane and Review Boundaries
pages.purpose: Describe agent, CI, provider-review, credential, pull-request, and validation boundaries. Emphasize that generated content and issue text cannot authorize changes.

pages.title: Wiki Publication and Knowledge Discovery
pages.purpose: Describe the distinct roles of in-repository wiki Markdown, GitHub Wiki, public DeepWiki, and Devin Wiki, including the validation-first policy and stale or drifted content handling.

pages.title: Repository Surface Reconciliation
pages.purpose: Document credential-scoped repository discovery, publisher state categories, daily read-only reports, explicit apply behavior, and pull-request-only reconciliation boundaries.
